items.headline: Bears' offense makes statement with 'amazing' 59-point opener
items.description: The Bears walked away from their opener with a historic 59-37 win over the Panthers, one that saw them score the fourth-most points in a game in franchise history and saw the teams combine for 96 points, most ever in a season opener.
